item.title: “I’m Not Playing This Show To Be Divisive”: Brantley Gilbert Responds To Critics Of Turning Point USA’s “All-American” Halftime Show
item.description: Country music artist Brantley Gilbert is speaking directly to those who are criticizing his involvement in the Turning Point USA “All-American Halftime Show.” Shortly after Bad Bunny was announced as the Apple Music halftime performer, the organization founded by the late Charlie Kirk shared that they’d be staging a “pro-America” halftime show to act as counter-programming. From the very beginning, Turning Point USA has maintained that their show will be “celebrating faith, family, and freedom.”
